name: Warsong Oil
summary: At the Warsong Lumber Camp, Warsong Oil keeps the machinery turning. Satyrs have taken a shipment into their corrupted enclaves.

sections.title: Stolen Machinery Fuel
sections.body: Warsong Oil keeps the Warsong Clan’s logging machinery running in Ashenvale. Goblin-engineered shredders and great sawmills depend on its steady supply. Without the lubricant, timber cutting could stop. Then the lumber needed to build Orgrimmar and strengthen Horde settlements across Durotar and the Barrens would slow.

sections.title: Rituals of the Satyr
sections.body: Satyrs ambushed a shipment of Warsong Oil before it could reach Splintertree Post and the logging camps. They carried the containers into corrupted enclaves, including Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian. There, the satyrs use the flammable lubricant in their rituals.

faq.q: What is Warsong Oil used for?
faq.answer: Warsong Oil keeps the heavy shredders, saws, and timber-cutting machinery at the Warsong Lumber Camp running.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs have the oil?
faq.answer: Satyrs ambushed a supply convoy bound for Splintertree Post on Ashenvale’s roads. They took the oil for rituals in ruined settlements.

faq.q: Where can Warsong Oil be found?
faq.answer: Satyr-controlled sites in Ashenvale hold Warsong Oil, especially Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian.
Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post needs Warsong Oil, saw blades, rope, and axes to resupply the struggling Warsong lumber operation.

angles.text: For the Horde, Ashenvale timber helps support its footholds in Durotar and the Barrens. When demon-worshiping satyrs take the machinery oil, construction in those young settlements suffers.
As an engineer, you know goblin-designed shredder joints and buzzsaws need steady lubrication. Without it, they burn out within hours of timber logging.
